verdict.rationale: Attio documents custom fields and attribute types, and offers kanban and table views of data. That covers the core of the customization story. Filtering and sorting are only evidenced as REST API request parameters, not as UI views. Nothing shows views can be shared or that a non-admin ops user can do this, and some object settings (e.g. enabling Deals) are admin-only. Missing for 10: evidence of filtered and sorted UI views, shared or team views, non-admin permission to add fields, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project

citations.quote: Customize fields to capture exactly what you need to track.
From kanbans to tables, visualize your data the way that works for you.
